title: Looking at photographs of musicians
summary: They view recent photographs including a Fairfield, Connecticut picture with Erskine Hawkins.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: We're just looking at a photo of someone who I think might make a claim that his instrument was playing something that Louis Armstrong never played. It's a photo of Maxine with her pocket trumpet.
Oh, yeah. Who's the piano player, Maxie?
That's Gene -- that picture was taken up in Fairfield, Connecticut. I work up there. Bill Ratzenberger gave me that pocket trumpet.
Is Erskine Hawkins still up that way?
I don't know, I haven't seen Erskine since I don't know when.

It was a couple of years ago.
